description:
## Problem
Two measurements cannot run on the 16 GiB Mac. (1) The DataFrame memory guard's subset estimate for TPC-DS Q16+Q94+Q95 together at SF10 (Polars 9.1 GiB, DataFusion 8.19 GiB, PySpark 13.65 GiB; `benchbox/core/dataframe/memory_model.py`) has never been compared with a measured peak; all 28 smaller Polars/DataFusion cells measured below their estimates (results: ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/df-memory-guard-subset/table.md). (2) The distinct-count NULL fix has no timing at PySpark SF1 or Polars/DataFusion SF10, comparing base 0eeec0d5bd194ad0b811911ea73004586ed51469 with develop.

## Trigger
Blocked until the owner names a host with at least 32 GiB RAM that BenchBox heavy-work admission accepts. Do not rent or start cloud machines without the owner's approval in that task.

## Method
1. Memory: run each engine on TPC-DS Q16, Q94, Q95 at SF10 with cached data, 2 runs per cell, recording peak RSS of the whole process tree, engine and library versions, and free memory before the run.
2. Timing: base vs develop, alternating arms, one warm-up then best of 5, PySpark at SF1 and Polars/DataFusion at SF10 on the queries used by df-distinct-timing-confirmation.

## Decision gate
- Any measured peak above its estimate: raise that engine's multiplier or floor so the estimate covers the peak plus the 20% margin (pre-approved). Peaks below half the estimate: report a proposed lower value; lowering needs the owner.
- Any develop/base timing ratio above 1.10 on a pattern: change or revert that pattern per the distinct-count rule, in its own PR; at or below 1.10: record and close.

## Guardrails
Timing and memory runs only through `make heavy-run` after `make heavy-status`; never force admission, set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK, disable the watchdog, or pass `--ignore-memory-warnings` without the owner's approval in that task. Never kill processes by pattern; the host is shared. No reference-answer changes. Record exact versions and host specs with every number.
